name: Uro i Europa — daglig spalte om sivil uro i Frankrike og Europa
_schedule_note: 06:25 Oslo. The desks run five minutes apart on this machine so they do not contend: daily-digest 06:00, world-brief 06:10, midterm-brief 06:20, this 06:25, publish 06:30. All inside the 08:00 deadline with room for the cloud runner being late.
_window_hours_note: 36 rather than 24: the French evening edition and the following morning's wrap are the two halves of the same night, and a 24-hour window splits them.
_overfetch_note: The beat draws from eleven foreign-language feeds, five of which are topical query feeds that return everything matching their query. Overfetching then ranking is what keeps a quiet night in Paris from being filled with a protest in another country entirely.
_provider_note: gemini like the other news desks. The column is mostly summarising and attributing foreign-language reporting rather than writing prose, which is the task this model is steadiest at.
_max_revisions_note: 0. The ethics screens on this beat fire on the SUBJECT -- arrests, ethnicity in the political debate, injuries -- not on any abuse of it. A redraft cannot clear them without abandoning the story, and would sand off the attributed detail that makes the column worth reading. The flags publish as warnings instead.
